verdict.rationale: Amplitude has a dedicated first-party MCP server page, confirmed by a probe. It says the server brings Amplitude's behavioral context into AI tools such as Claude, Cursor and OpenAI, so an agent can connect and query product data. The evidence is marketing-level, though: missing for 10: documented setup/endpoint and authentication details, list of exposed MCP tools/capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://amplitude.com/mcp-server
